description: Na₃FeO₃ crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. There are twelve inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.59 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.58 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ trigonal pyramids that share corners with four FeO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.40 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.58 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ trigonal pyramids that share corners with four FeO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids. There are three shorter (2.34 Å) and one longer (2.36 Å) Na-O bond length. In the sixth Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ trigonal pyramids that share corners with four FeO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.37 Å. In the seventh Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.68 Å. In the eighth Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.64 Å. In the ninth Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.76 Å. In the tenth Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.60 Å. In the eleventh Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ trigonal pyramids that share corners with four FeO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.44 Å. In the twelfth Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.66 Å. There are four inequivalent Fe sites. In the first Fe site, Fe is bonded to four O atoms to form FeO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent FeO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four NaO₄ trigonal pyramids. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 1.88-2.04 Å. In the second Fe site, Fe is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted FeO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent FeO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four NaO₄ trigonal pyramids. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 1.91-2.17 Å. In the third Fe site, Fe is bonded to four O atoms to form FeO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent FeO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four NaO₄ trigonal pyramids. There are two shorter (1.80 Å) and two longer (1.81 Å) Fe-O bond lengths. In the fourth Fe site, Fe is bonded to four O atoms to form FeO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent FeO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four NaO₄ trigonal pyramids. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 1.86-2.04 Å. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na and two Fe atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded to four Na and two Fe atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₄Fe₂ octahedra. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na and two Fe atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to four Na and two Fe atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner, edge, and face-sharing ONa₄Fe₂ octahedra. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one Fe atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Fe atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₅Fe octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 36-37°. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Fe atom to form distorted ONa₅Fe pentagonal pyramids that share corners with four ONa₄Fe₂ octahedra and faces with two ONa₅Fe octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 53-56°. In the eighth O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Fe atom to form distorted ONa₅Fe pentagonal pyramids that share corners with nine ONa₄Fe₂ octahedra and  a faceface with one ONa₅Fe octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 37-67°. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one Fe atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one Fe atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Fe atom to form distorted ONa₅Fe octahedra that share corners with two equivalent ONa₅Fe octahedra, corners with two equivalent ONa₅Fe pentagonal pyramids, edges with two equivalent ONa₄Fe₂ octahedra, and  a faceface with one ONa₅Fe pentagonal pyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 36-37°. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Fe atom to form ONa₅Fe octahedra that share corners with two equivalent ONa₅Fe pentagonal pyramids, edges with three ONa₄Fe₂ octahedra, and  a faceface with one ONa₅Fe pentagonal pyramid.
